items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: You could hear Eddie Jackson one mile off.

ctx.x: What about tuba? They have any good tuba players?

Tuba, yeah. Well they had Jackson, I can't think of the guy, not any of Jackson, another Jackson. He was good. They had Oak Gaspar, he was a good tuba player. Later on in years came a very good tuba player. What everybody knew was that. He was a little slim fella. Tall and slim. That was Eddie Jackson. You could hear Eddie Jackson one mile off. One mile off. He wasn't a big guy, huh? He wasn't a big guy, no. Slim man. Very small man. Thin man. Tall. Did he play good besides being high? Yeah, he played good, yeah.…
I made some recording with the Dukes of Dixieland.
